newsitem.title: ITALY: Unions call eight hour strike at Olivetti.
newsitem.headline: Unions call eight hour strike at Olivetti.

text.p: Unions at Olivetti on Wednesday announced an eight hour strike at the troubled information and technology group to protest against recently announced re-structuring plans at the company.
Metalworker unions said the strike would be held across the Olivetti group on October 18.
Olivetti's chief executive officer Roberto Colaninno last week announced that the company would sell its loss-making personal computer business by end-year.

"Olivetti's scientific, professional and human assets cannot be dispersed. They are assets which belong to the whole country and must be protected," a joint statement by Italy's big three metal industry unions said.
The statement also called on the government to intervene and help resolve the crisis.
